title: Music of the Era
subtitle: At the "Crater" Music Festival, the crowd moves in rhythm to the chorus of "Night of Revelry." What's this on the ground? Hey, look what I found!

trails.title: Budget Crisis
trails.description: Damn, this expense report is absolutely astronomical.

content.text:
...

Dragon Tree Resin Compasses—Compasses carved from the resin of dragon blood trees, serving as the activation stimulus of the Eastern astrology arcane skill on telescopes, used for navigation in extreme environments.

Note: Procure dragon blood (the sap of the dragon tree) for re-manufacturing. To ensure foolproof production, an external contract has been issued for collecting genuine dragon blood.

Obsidian Crystals—Utilizing obsidian crystals to produce solar panels was a proposal by some arcanists of that time. The ingenious application of Aztec arcane skills significantly enhanced the efficiency of solar energy absorption.

Note: On-site collection at Popocatepetl Volcano, along with lab-produced control samples.

Wide-field Camera—The wide-field planetary camera (WFPC) with the highest resolution of that time provided by Caltech, responsible for capturing image data.

Note: Send a specialist to negotiate, requesting a camera and a design blueprint if possible. The price is of no issue.

Astronomical Spectrometer—The telescope is equipped with various sized spectrometers, integrating both spectral and photographic functions, used for gathering spectral data.

Note: A labor-intensive task; retrieve all existing spectrometer designs from Laplace, and commission expedited production from major corporations.

High-speed Photometer—An instrument used to measure the brightness and polarization variations of celestial bodies. It was decommissioned before the first "Storm" due to malfunctions.

Note: Even if decommissioned, it can't be overlooked. The museum might have replacement parts.

Space Seeds—Seeds prepared for the activation environment of certain arcane skills at that time. Each seed was meticulously selected and symbolically significant.

Note: The original conditions cannot be fully recreated, but similar substitutes can be found. Request as many as possible from Plesetsk.

"Regulus" Record—The power source of the telescope, shrouded in complete mystery as the most enigmatic component of the apparatus.

Note: The owner has been identified. The entanglement of identical names brings inextricable fate into play ... though unscientific, this must also be considered.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Achoo! Ugh, the dust in here! What, are we inside some kind of vacuum cleaner?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Is that why you always wear that fish tank on your head?
Familiar with Regulus's quirks, Ulrich opts for the most efficient form of communication: none.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What's got you so quiet? Pulling the "strong and silent" act now?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Here we are.
Laplace Launch Site, Cronulla
The site has been utterly neglected. Dust and debris litter every corner of it.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Here, as in ...?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: The Laplace launch site in Sydney. We've collaborated with the Foundation and the space agency for various projects here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Thanks for the heads-up. I almost thought we'd just barged into some rock star's house.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: It will actually take another two years before this place becomes an official launch site.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh! Yeah, right, we're basically living in the past.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I visited various launch sites to verify the photos—Guiana Space Centre, Plesetsk Cosmodrome—then, I found this place.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Most of its archives were lost in the "Storm," but a small portion of the early records survived.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I left them here with the rest of the files I compiled.
Papers scatter into the air as he rummages through the files.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Damn it! Where did they go?!
The ferrofluid tremors in his tank.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, does this mean we can all go home now?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Absolutely not!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Alright, new task: Stay put and don't touch anything. I need to find those files.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ugh, fine.
As Ulrich makes his exit, Regulus scans the room, a glint growing behind her eyes.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh! Amazing!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: An old military base, mysterious photos ... Oh, this is going to be juicy!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No chance Ulrich is stopping this rockin' pirate from going after treasure, I mean, very, very important files.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The hunt is on!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Haha! Let's start with what's on this table!
The clinking and clattering of rummaging fills the air, like a string of cheerful musical notes.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, I almost forgot! Can't go treasure hunting without some music to rock out to!
Turning the knob, she powers up the amplifier.
The world belongs to rock!
The vibrations reach Ulrich, causing the ferrofluid to ripple.
Even the desk is trembling.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Damn it! I forgot to tell her to keep quiet!
Squawk!
The screech of a bird pierces through the pumping music.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: What's happening? Is this an earthquake?
A few agile black shadows leap around the upper parts of the observation deck.
The tremors free a note pinned to the wall, and it flutters down to the ground.
The handwriting is all too familiar:

"Investigator's Report: Multiple Tripodero attacks on humans have occurred 
in the area."

"They seem to regard this abandoned facility as their territory, attacking 
any intruders."

"Remember: Keep your movements quiet!!!"

                                                                                  
                                                                                                          Ulrich

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Ah, crap! This is the note I wrote last time I was here!
The ferrofluid ripples violently.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Regulus! Turn off that speaker! Now!
Regulus is too immersed in her treasure-seeking to hear him.

items.speaker: Tripodero
items.text: Squawk!
A glob of dark green sludge shoots down from above. Ulrich darts aside, narrowly avoiding the attack.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: For flux's sake!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I knew I should have upgraded my memo module!
He looks to the observation deck. There is Regulus, gleefully twisting to the music.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Calm down, Ulrich. You're a leader. It's part of your job to clean up after your team.
He looks over the priceless equipment around him and sighs before ducking through the emergency exit.
The Tripoderos follow in hot pursuit.
